QuestInfo.name: Camila's Gem
QuestInfo.0: I hear that #p204# in #m10001000# is worried about something...
QuestInfo.1: I met #p204# in #m10001000#, and, because of her timid disposition, she needs me to deliver #b#t4031008##k to #b#p225##k for her. I can get to #m10001082# through #m10001080#...
QuestInfo.2: I delivered a gift from #p204# to #p225#. I'm sure they're really close friends, since they're giving each other what's most precious to themselves. I wish I could meet a friend like that during my journey...

0.0: My friend #b#p225##k grew up with me and has a birthday coming up in a few days. So, I've decided my gift will be my precious #b#t4031008##k.
0.1: There's a problem, though. #p225# hasn't been coming uptown lately, probably because he's been swarmed with work. I'd like to go there and give it to him myself, but the #o92#s that he raises scare me to death. Well... if you have any time, can you get this marble to #p225# for me?

yes.0: Really? Thank you, thank you so much! Here's the marble. I even carved a message for #p225# on it. You can get to Utah's farm through #m010001080#. Good luck!

no.0: Oh, I see. Sorry for asking. You must be a very busy person... #p225# might be disappointed... sigh... what should I do now??

1.0: Who are you? Whoa, isn't that the marble that #p204# so preciously takes care of? How did you get that??? What? #p204# asked you to give me that for my birthday? Wow, that's just awesome. This is a very precious item, you know. Now that the farming is almost done, I may have to go see #p204# to say thanks.

yes.0: Thanks for delivering #p204#'s present to me. Did you get my reward? Hopefully it'll help you on your journey.

npc.0: Oh, the marble... Have you not seen #p225# yet? Please get him the present before his birthday passes. Did you lose your way to #m10001082# by any chance?
npc.1: Head to #m10001080# and you'll see the entrance to #m10001082#. Avoid the #o92#s and traps and navigate your way through the hidden paths, and you'll find him.

item.0: Who are you? This is our farm, and we raise a bunch of #o92#s. They are much stronger than the #o10#s that are raised out in the wild. Anyway, how can I help you?

lost.0: Ah, did you lose the marble that I gave you by any chance? Someone picked it up from the streets a couple of minutes ago. This is something I really cherish, so please take good care of it, and get it to #p225# ASAP.
